validation.numbers: Finite nonnegative integers only for counts; reject strings, booleans, fractions, negatives and missing required counts.
validation.strings: Trim and require nonempty where required. Escape on display/PDF. Page IDs must be unique and page names nonempty.
validation.unknownFieldsOrIds: Reject unknown price-bearing fields and IDs; show a validation/review message rather than silently dropping requested work.
validation.crossFileReferences: priceRef resolves against pricing.json; capability IDs resolve against capabilityLabels; option IDs and all conditions must be supported by the consuming client.
